comment: Domain-root SACL audit rule for Sentinel monitoring. Optional add-on — loaded only when -EnableAuditing is specified.

domainAuditRule.comment: Canonical audit ACE applied to the domain root DN ({{DOMAIN_DN}}). Trustee is Everyone (S-1-1-0), AuditFlags=Success, InheritanceType=All, non-inherited. Rights are the union target; any customer rights already present beyond these 9 are PRESERVED (UNION converge).
